cohort: 4396 women with obstetric fistulas presenting for repair who delivered previously in facilities between 1990 and 2014
finding: There is an increasing trend of performing cesarean sections on women with obstructed labor whose babies have already died in utero in Eastern and Central Africa.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates are increasing, while assisted vaginal deliveries are decreasing for women with obstructed labor and intrauterine fetal death.
country: Tanzania, Uganda, Kenya, Malawi, Rwanda, Somalia, South Sudan, Zambia and Ethiopia
